summary_md: **恒星sun ([@vintcessun](https://x.com/vintcessun/status/2116477034713264281))** highlights *Trace2World* by Wang et al. ([arXiv 2610.30792](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30792)), which rebuilds 50 GUI app environments from 1,570 real traces with evidence for every action effect and replay validation, raising sim-to-real retention of training gains from 54.7% to 94.0%.

referenced_urls.title: Trace2World: Reconstructing App Worlds from Real Interaction...

relevance: Faithful environments for GUI agent RL.
